name: Transco Mobile Bay Lateral Expansion

values.SegmentName: Mobile Bay Lateral Expansion Project, Phase 1
values.OtherEnglishNames: Mobile Bay Lateral Extension and Expansion Project
values.EndLocation: Main Pass Viosca Knoll Block 261 platform, offshore
values.Owner: Transcontinental Gas Pipe Line Company LLC

researcher_notes: Not an existing row. P2627 is a 2011 Florida Gas Transmission lateral with a similar name, and no Transcontinental row covers this 1998 project. The Federal Register notice of December 4, 1997 (FERC environmental assessment, Transco docket CP97-92) describes 75.66 miles of new pipe: 19.08 miles of 30-inch from Compressor Station 82 in Mobile County, Alabama to a platform in Mobile Block 822, and 56.58 miles of 24-inch on to Main Pass Viosca Knoll Block 261. The EIA Natural Gas Pipeline Projects release of August 2026, Historical Projects sheet, Excel row 80, project Transco Mobile Bay Lat Expansion I, lists Completed, in service 1998, 76 miles, 350 MMcf/d, 24 inch, cost 120.2 million dollars, docket CP97-92. EIA and the Federal Register notice are different publishers. Transco 10-Q (SEC, 1997) was not machine-checkable and is not cited. Length of 75.66 miles passes the 25 km rule. Station 82 end-point coordinates and the offshore platform end point are described in words only. Route not found, so no route is proposed. Segment name follows the existing Hillabee-style convention. Diameter holds two values, 30 and 24 inches, for a person to format as the sheet does.
